description:
Configure Jitsi Meet for a distraction-free 'Focus Mode'. 

1. Locate the Jitsi Meet web configuration directory (mapped to ~/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web).
2. Create or edit 'custom-interface_config.js' to override settings.
3. Set the application name (APP_NAME) to 'ExamPortal'.
4. Configure the toolbar (TOOLBAR_BUTTONS) to include ONLY these buttons: 'microphone', 'camera', 'desktop', 'fullscreen', 'hangup', 'raisehand', 'chat', 'tileview'. All other buttons (Invite, Security, Video Quality, etc.) must be removed.
5. Restart the Jitsi web container to apply changes.
6. Verify the changes in the browser.
7. Save a screenshot of the simplified toolbar to ~/Documents/focus_mode_toolbar.png.
8. Save a screenshot showing the 'ExamPortal' branding to ~/Documents/focus_mode_branding.png.
